## Events to email

Every 5 minutes it reads the site event feed after the saved cursor and sends ONE digest email (Romanian, no diacritics) when there are alerts: delivery_failed, delivery_stale, account_reconnect_required, manual_due, drafts_ready, generation_failed, foreign_post, worker_silent. Nothing is sent when there is nothing new.

1. Edit **Config** (site URL, admin link, from and to addresses).
2. Pick **Agent Social automation** on the HTTP nodes and **Agent Social SMTP** on **Send digest**.
3. Activate the workflow.

The cursor lives in workflow static data, which n8n keeps only for an ACTIVE workflow. A manual test run does not move it, so the next real run repeats those events. The cursor moves only after the email was sent; if SMTP fails, the same events are retried in 5 minutes.

Events older than `maxAgeHours` are skipped (not emailed), so the first run on an existing install does not mail the whole history. Runs are logged as `events-<last id>`; an idle check is logged once per hour.
